summary.intent: Execute the /gsd plan-phase workflow end-to-end for phase 69 (FUSE/WinFSP Rust integration with grant-root awareness) in the cipher-box-phase69 repo: run research, materialize validation strategy, pattern-map source files, then spawn the planner and verification loop.
summary.outcome: Completed the research gate (RESEARCH.md committed), materialized and committed VALIDATION.md from the research's Validation Architecture section, ran and committed pattern-mapping (PATTERNS.md, 17 files classified), and confirmed API-SURFACE regen/drift checks were non-blocking for this Rust phase — session ends just before spawning the planner.

repo: Phase 69's grant-root scope algorithm has a complete TS reference at packages/sdk-core/src/rotation/scope.ts, so it's a port rather than a design-from-scratch task.
activeGrantRootIpnsNames is sourced from GET /shares/sent, which has no crates/api-client wrapper yet — a real gap surfaced by the researcher.

The API-SURFACE regen (intel plan:pre hook) is TS/JS-focused and returns symbolCount: 0, stale: true for Rust-only phases — expected, not an error, and safely omitted from planner prompts when RESEARCH.md already has verified symbol locations.

The codebase drift check flagged action_required with 143 elements, but for phase 69 it was entirely noise in .claude/, .learnings/, landing/, and root config — none inside crates/ — so it didn't block or degrade planning.
Pattern-mapper flagged rotation/engine.rs and write_ops/grant_scope.rs as thin-precedent files (weaker existing-pattern analogs) among the 17 net-new Rust files.
workflow: The commit helper can report commit_failed as a false negative even when lint-staged completes cleanly and the commit actually lands — verify via git log before retrying rather than trusting the reported status.
VALIDATION.md is materialized by extracting the researcher's '## Validation Architecture' section from RESEARCH.md and filling the VALIDATION.md template's frontmatter/infrastructure/sampling fields.
PATTERNS.md (pattern-mapper output) is not committed by the default plan-phase flow and must be committed explicitly.

friction: API-SURFACE regen returned an empty/stale result for the Rust phase since the extractor doesn't support Rust — required judgment to discard rather than feed to the planner.
VALIDATION.md commit reported commit_failed, requiring a manual follow-up check of git log to confirm it was a known false-negative and the commit actually succeeded.
open_items: No crates/api-client wrapper exists yet for GET /shares/sent, needed to source activeGrantRootIpnsNames — flagged as a gap for the planner/implementation, not yet resolved.

Planner (gsd-planner) and verification loop (gsd-plan-checker) have not yet been spawned — phase 69 planning is incomplete as of end of transcript.
